deploy_and_verify_prod.s:
Ship and prove the fix on the live deployment. No unit tests (ops step); the 'tests' phase is the live verification below. Prereqs: authenticated wrangler (already true on this machine — whoami shows scopes workers_scripts/write, workers_tail/read, secrets_store/write), both workers' code green from the previous steps.

PHASE 1 — deploy BOTH workers:
- x2: `npx wrangler deploy` (root; builds via .svelte-kit/cloudflare/_worker.js).
- x2-ws: `npx wrangler deploy` run with workdir ws/ (the ws/wrangler.jsonc; the durable object migration tag is unchanged so no migration warning).
Wait for both deployments to show new Version(s) in `npx wrangler deployments list`.

PHASE 2 — repeat the LIVE reproduction that failed before the fix (this is what made the root cause obvious):
1. Create a throwaway account (e.g. nptest_b@t.com, already exists from the diagnosis — reuse it; password password123) and log in via `curl -c /tmp/b.jar -X POST https://x2.apexlinks.workers.dev/api/auth/login -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"e":"nptest_b@t.com","p":"password123"}'`.
2. Register a DELIBERATELY CORRUPT sub: POST /api/push/subscribe with endpoint https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send/fake-a, p256dh = base64url of 65 RANDOM bytes not starting 0x04, auth = base64url of 16 random bytes.
3. Register a VALID sub on the same account: POST /api/push/subscribe with endpoint https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send/fake-b, p256dh = the canonical 0x04 point `BOU-1nvLFd0AC5crjR73SNC4goNO-tSx3QRWpiK_jlzlme_Q-pnC7vBfYDuFdKCYtuc1H5qNGOSBbqylIArRmqs`, auth = `reBg-YN5Ix6V6pKwKxHB6g`.
4. Start `npx wrangler tail x2-ws --format pretty` (workdir ws/) writing to /tmp/ws_tail.log.
5. From a second account (nptest_a@t.com/password123) POST /api/send to the first account's uid (uid = uuid_from(email) = SHA-256('x2:'+email)[0:16]; nptest_b's = cedab23a-e019-4060-8ec9-dabdb9ad594f).
6. Read /tmp/ws_tail.log: PASS = NO `[RELAY] ... DO fetch THREW` line, NO `Exception Thrown`, and a `[HUB-PUSH] sub sub:... failed — pruning:` line for the corrupt sub. FAIL = the old `DataError: Failed to import raw EC key data` + Exception Thrown (means the deployed x2-ws predates the fix — redeploy).
7. Confirm self-heal: POST /api/send again to the same account — the corrupt sub is already pruned, so expect the relay to be Ok with NO pruning line this time. (Both fake FCM endpoints 404 -> gone -> both subs pruned by the pre-existing gone path; that is expected and harmless on a throwaway account.)

PHASE 3 — sanity that normal push still flows: with the valid sub still present (re-register if the previous step pruned it), send a third message; expect relay Ok and (optionally, if FCM is reachable from this network) a 404 response logged via `[HUB-PUSH]` — the point is NO throw, NO Exception Thrown.

PHASE 4 — clean up: kill the tail; no repo change is required for deployment (the ws worker picks up the committed code), so `git status` clean of ws/.env changes (ws/.env is gitignored — confirm untracked). Delete this plan file and `git push` per the plans workflow.
